description: This file contains tests for CLI command parsing and behavior, including argument rewriting, primary command registration conditions, plugin registration skipping, CLI path enforcement, and help fast path handling, specific to the 'openclaw' CLI tool.

methods.name: rewriteUpdateFlagArgv
methods.description: Rewrites command-line arguments to replace '--update' with 'update' command.

methods.name: resolveMissingBrowserCommandMessage
methods.description: Provides explanatory messages when the browser command is missing due to plugin restrictions.

methods.name: shouldEnsureCliPath
methods.description: Determines if the CLI path should be enforced based on the command arguments.

methods.name: shouldRegisterPrimarySubcommand
methods.description: Decides whether to eagerly register the primary subcommand based on invocation parameters.

methods.name: shouldSkipPluginCommandRegistration
methods.description: Checks if plugin registration should be skipped based on CLI invocation context.

methods.name: shouldUseRootHelpFastPath
methods.description: Determines if the fast help path should be utilized for root help commands.
